title: Canonical persona / sub-agent source
description: Vendor-agnostic actor definition (intent/1-personas/spec.md, D1-D9). No model IDs, harness names, or tool names appear here or in any conforming source; tiers are semantic and capabilities abstract. CI additionally greps personas/** for vendor leakage (D3).

name.description: Actor name; must equal the source filename minus .yaml.

kind.description: persona = GitHub-identity actor owning lifecycle stages; subagent = compiled worker with no identity (D2).

stage.description: Lifecycle stages the persona owns. Personas only; sub-agents serve any stage through their parent.

escalation_tier.description: Optional higher grade the actor may escalate to (e.g. implementation work hitting a debugging wall).

role.description: The behavioral contract: what the actor does, what it refuses to do, and how it hands control back.

skills.description: Filenames in personas/skills/, inlined by the compiler in declared order (D5).

name.description: Abstract capability; mapped to concrete tools per harness in config/tools.yaml (D4).

required.description: true: a harness that cannot map it fails compilation. false: the compiler emits a generated fallback instruction instead (D4).

authority.description: Declared here so compiled prompts state their bounds; ENFORCED mechanically by branch protection, merge-gate path checks, and token scopes — never by prompt (D6).

github_write.description: Write ladder, each grade including the ones below: none < comments < issues (issues + comments) < branch:<glob> (push matching branches + PRs + issues + comments). Never the default branch.

paths.description: Repo path globs the actor's PRs may touch; checked at the merge gate.

identity.description: GitHub App bot login the actor acts as, e.g. 'evekhm-athena-app[bot]', or 'TBD' until the identity decision (#7) resolves it.

app_id.description: GitHub App ID (public — visible on the App's settings page, safe to commit). Legacy JWT issuer; prefer client_id (GitHub's current recommendation). Omitted until the App is registered (#7).

client_id.description: GitHub App's Client ID (public, safe to commit) — the JWT `iss` claim GitHub now recommends over the legacy numeric app_id. Omitted until the App is registered (#7).

installation_id.description: Installation ID of the App on this repo (public, safe to commit). Omitted until the App is installed (#7).

token.description: Secret NAME (Actions secret / env var, or looked up under ~/.keys/ locally per scripts/auth/_github_app.py) holding the App's private key. Never a value, never a path (D6).

delegates_to.description: Sub-agent names this persona may dispatch. Personas only; sub-agents never spawn sub-agents (D7).

limits.description: Execution caps. Required for personas (D9); optional for sub-agents (harness defaults apply).

tier.description: The five-grade semantic ladder from AGENTS.md; bound to models per harness in config/model_tiers.yaml, never here (D3).

advances_on.description: What event fires a lifecycle rung (#57 D4): the row's artifact being added, a merged pull request, or null for the terminal review rung.
